name: Still Point Yoga PRD Success metrics and Out of scope
description: Success metrics and Out of scope sections of the Still Point Yoga PRD. Metrics are checkable by reading the page, each names its goal, and no numbers are invented.

fields.description: one metric per goal, each checkable by reading the page

fields.name: goal

fields.name: metric
fields.description: what is checked by reading the page

fields.name: target
fields.description: the state to reach, with no invented numbers

fields.name: window
fields.description: the measurement window; write "measurement window not set" when the brief doesn't say
